# Article 24
Entry into force This Law shall enter into force on the day of its publication in the Official Gazette of the Republic of Kosovo, with financial effect on 1 January 2018. Law No. 06/L-020 22 December 2017 Promulgated by Decree No.DL-001-2018, dated 09.01.2018, President of the Republic of Kosovo Hashim Thaçi. _______________________________ Tables of the Law no. 06 / L -020 on the Budget of the Republic of Kosovo for 2018 attached by the law are published in the Official Gazette website (gzk.rks-gov.net)
